title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OFFICE FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY TO THE OFFICE OF THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY

text.en:
The Intellectual Property Office (IPO) is hereby transferred
from the Department of Trade and Industry to the Office of the Executive
PGMA Outgoino • 0

The Office of the Executive Secretary, consistent with the
Constitution and the law, shall assume oversight and other functions,
administrative or otherwise, over the IPO. However, unless otherwise directed,
administrative appeals shall continue to be geverned by the relevant provisions of
the Intellectual Property Code.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof which
are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila this 8th day of October in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and One.
By the President:
"ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
